2607.18691.title: Semantic Primes as Explanans for Emotion in Large Language Models
2607.18691.paper_summary: Progresses have been made on understanding emotion mechanisms of large language models (LLMs). However, how to explain emotion in LLMs, or even what constitutes good explanations, are less clear. Emotion representations, components, circuits are widely recoverable, but as explanations of a model's own computation they are circular; the emotion space dimensions tend to be arbitrary and non-terminating. A pressing question to ask is whether a more primitive set of internal variables does the work: the semantic primes of the Natural Semantic Metalanguage (NSM). Across four instruction-tuned LLMs (Llama-1B, Gemma-2B, Gemma-9B, OLMo-7B), experiments show that the NSM primes are (1) recoverable internal elements; and (2) on the reference model, intervening with a prime based direction controls emotion about three times as strongly, and twice as selectively, as the best appraisal based direction; and (3) the model treats a prime based explication as interchangeable with the corresponding emotion. These evidences suggest that NSM primes seem to be better explanans for emotion in LLMs than many alternative options according to scientific explanations criteria.
2607.18691.paper_summary_zh: 在理解大型語言模型（LLMs）的情感機制方面已取得進展。<lb/>然而，如何解釋LLMs中的情感，甚至什麼構成良好的解釋，仍然不太清楚。<lb/>情感的表徵、組成部分和電路是廣泛可恢復的，但作為模型自身計算的解釋，它們是循環的；情感空間的維度往往是任意的且無法終止。<lb/>一個迫切需要提出的問題是，是否有一組更原始的內部變量在發揮作用：自然語義元語言（NSM）的語義原語。<lb/>在四個經過指令調整的LLMs（Llama-1B、Gemma-2B、Gemma-9B、OLMo-7B）中，實驗顯示NSM原語是（1）可恢復的內部元素；<lb/>(2) 在參考模型上，基於原語的干預方向對情感的控制強度約為最佳評價基準方向的三倍，且選擇性是兩倍；<lb/>(3) 該模型將基於原語的解釋視為與相應情感可互換。<lb/>這些證據表明，根據科學解釋標準，NSM原語似乎比許多替代選擇更能有效解釋LLMs中的情感。
